name: Second Sun
description: The smaller of the twin suns, which approached Bolas's Horn Monument as a harbinger of his return.

timeline.summary: The Hours begin when the Second Sun rests between the horns on the horizon.
timeline.quote: When the Second Sun rests between the horns on the horizon, so begins the Hour of Revelation.
